snippet.title: Season 18 Mythic Gameplay Trailer | Overwatch 2
snippet.description:
Take the competition by storm with Season 18’s brand new Mythics!

Bring a new spectrum of justice to the battlefield with the Mythic Ultraviolet Sentinel Sojourn Hero Skin. With each new level you unlock, watch as her Mythic Skin comes to life with sleek cybernetic visual effects, custom high-tech sounds, and stunning colorways for a more commanding presence on the battlefield.

And that’s not the only Mythic arriving at Season 18’s launch! Bring the heat from sunrise to sunset with the Mythic Blazing Sunsetter Cassidy Weapon Skin. As you rack up eliminations, the revolver overheats, ejecting pieces of its casing until all that’s left is its fiery core. Combine that with a deadly flourish and some lethal kill effects, and you’ve got yourself a molten masterpiece.

Unlock the Mythic Ultraviolet Sentinel Sojourn Hero Skin and the Mythic Blazing Sunsetter Cassidy Weapon Skin when you jump into Season 18: Stadium Quick Play today!

Overwatch 2 is free to play for everyone on console & PC!
